req.title: Basic-auth rejects wrong password
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 401 and WWW-Authenticate: Basic when Basic-auth credentials are missing or wrong.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> must return HTTP 401 with WWW-Authenticate: Basic when credentials are missing or wrong, and HTTP 200 with authenticated payload when correct. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — correct credentials yield 200 + exact JSON; (2) negative EP — wrong password yields 401 + WWW-Authenticate header; (3) negative EP — missing Authorization header yields 401; (4) DT — correct user but wrong password (boolean short-circuit on auth.password == passwd); (5) DT — wrong user but correct password (boolean short-circuit on auth.username == user); (6) BVA — empty string credentials; (7) NEG — no Authorization header at all. Each assertion uses exact values to kill constant, comparison, and boolean-negation mutations.

tests.name: test_basic_auth_correct_credentials_returns_200_with_payload
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Create test client from httpbin app
Send GET /basic-auth/myuser/mypass with correct Basic auth header for myuser:mypass
expected: JSON body contains authenticated=true and user='myuser'
trace: R-HTTPBIN-019 expected outcome: HTTP 2xx with expected payload
check_basic_auth returns True when credentials match
basic_auth returns jsonify(authenticated=True, user=user)
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()
creds = base64.b64encode(b'myuser:mypass').decode('ascii')
headers = {'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'}
r = client.get('/basic-auth/myuser/mypass', headers=headers)
assert r.status_code == 200
data = r.get_json()
assert data['authenticated'] == True
assert data['user'] == 'myuser'
assert 'authenticated' in data
assert len(data) == 2

def test_basic_auth_correct_credentials_returns_200_with_payload():
    client = app.test_client()
    creds = base64.b64encode(b'myuser:mypass').decode('ascii')
    headers = {'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'}
    r = client.get('/basic-auth/myuser/mypass', headers=headers)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data['authenticated'] == True
    assert data['user'] == 'myuser'
    assert len(data) == 2

tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

def test_basic_auth_wrong_password_returns_401_with_www_authenticate():
    client = app.test_client()
    creds = base64.b64encode(b'myuser:WRONGPASS').decode('ascii')
    headers = {'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'}
    r = client.get('/basic-auth/myuser/mypass', headers=headers)
    assert r.status_code == 401
    www_auth = r.headers.get('WWW-Authenticate', '')
    assert www_auth != ''
    assert www_auth.startswith('Basic')
    assert 'realm' in www_auth.lower()

from httpbin.core import app

def test_basic_auth_401_response_exact_www_authenticate_value():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/basic-auth/testuser/testpass')
    assert r.status_code == 401

    assert www_auth is not None
